newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips drift higher; pause ahead Christmas break.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips drift higher; pause ahead Christmas break.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks eked out small gains Monday as investors stepped aside after wrapping up their pre-Christmas buying spree last week.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 4.62 points at 6,489.02 following last week's robust 180-point rally. In the broader market, declining issues led advances 13-11 on light volume of 343 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
